sources.summary: Exclusive: Outsourced guards, largely from minority ethnic backgrounds, barred from staff hub for mainly white employees The National Gallery’s security staff, of whom the vast majority are from minority ethnic backgrounds, are facing shocking segregation, a senior curator has claimed. Its outsourced guards are barred from the building’s high-quality “hub” – bright and airy recreation rooms that are available to the institution’s mainly white employees. They are not allowed to take their breaks there, or even sit in that area. Continue reading...
